title: Reimbursements of infrastructure hosting costs {March 2023 - Sep 2023}
body:
Previously approved proposal:[ https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/10189-reimbursements-of-infrastructure-hosting-costs-nov-2022-feb-2023](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/10189-reimbursements-of-infrastructure-hosting-costs-nov-2022-feb-2023)

# Contributors Involved:
## JelliedOwl
- JelliedOwl is currently hosting geo-aware load-balanced RPC infrastructure (which is majorly used in PolkadotApps, EdgeApps, different wallets and block explorers for substrate/EdgeWASM and EdgeEVM environments). 
- Their previously approved individual proposal for the same:
- [https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/6607-public-rpc-and-bootnodes-jelliedowl](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/6607-public-rpc-and-bootnodes-jelliedowl)
- Hosting reimbursements per month: 500 USD equivalent in EDG


## Bharathcoorg
- Bharathcoorg is currently hosting block explorers of EdgeEVM/BeresheetEVM, Edgeverse extension & mobile wallet, Edgeverse DEX and Edgeverse Bridge portal.
- Their previously approved (related) proposals:
- [https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/4214-builders-program-application-blockexplorer-and-wallet/](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/4214-builders-program-application-blockexplorer-and-wallet/)
- [https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/8013-proposal-basic-evm-tools-for-edgeware-network/](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/8013-proposal-basic-evm-tools-for-edgeware-network/)
- Hosting reimbursements per month: 500 USD equivalent in EDG


**Combined reimbursements of the hosting costs:** 1000 USD equivalent in EDG per month

**Proposal period:** March 2023 - Sep 2023

- Trailing median of March 2022: 0.000723776 USD per EDG
- Trailing median of April 2022: 0.000703004 USD per EDG
- Trailing median of May 2022: 0.00032869 USD per EDG
- Trailing median of June 2022: 0.000273464 USD per EDG
- Trailing median of July 2022: 0.000236823 USD per EDG
- Trailing median of Aug 2022: 0.000141143 USD per EDG
- Trailing median of Sep 2022: 0.000135946 USD per EDG


- Reimbursements for March 2022: 1381643.225 EDG
